---
title: "Terry C."
---

Hi Terry! You have **two goals** in this game.

Your **first goal** is to find someone who went to Norway this year. There are 3 other people with this clue (and perhaps others who could have had this clue). See if you can find them all!

Your **second goal** is to find someone who is a scientist who worked (or now works) on water treatment. There is 1 other person with this clue (and perhaps others who could have had this clue). See if you can find them!
